hub.title: Free Short Scripts, Skits and Video Ideas for Creators
hub.description: {n} original scripts free to film or perform: 30–60 s sketches, short-drama episodes, skits for 3–6 people, duets and monologues, plus video idea lists.
hub.lede: Out of ideas? Pick a script and shoot it tonight. Every script here is original, comes with roles, a shot list or staging notes and performance tips, and is free to perform and film, even on monetised channels.
about: The short-video scripts are written for one phone in vertical 9:16, with 1–3 people and things you already have at home. The short-drama scripts are first episodes in the vertical micro-drama style, with a hook in the first seconds, a reversal and a cliffhanger. The skits are 4–7 minutes for a classroom or a school event, and the duets, monologues and voice drama are for acting class, auditions, self-tapes and recordings.

Every script is licensed CC BY 4.0: you may perform it, film it, translate it, change it and post it anywhere, including monetised channels, ads and competitions, as long as you credit “Script: cv.cm”. Each page also has AI shot prompts you can paste into a text-to-video model.

faq.q: Can I use these scripts on a monetised YouTube or TikTok channel?
faq.a: Yes. All scripts are under CC BY 4.0, which allows commercial use, including monetised videos, sponsored posts and ads. Credit “Script: cv.cm” in the caption or description.

faq.q: Can I change the script, the names or the number of people?
faq.a: Yes. Change lines, names, genders, settings and the ending, cut or add roles, or translate it. Each script lists three ready-made variations to start from. Keep the credit.

faq.q: Which script should I pick for a school performance?
faq.a: Look under Skits for 3–6 people: they run 4–7 minutes, need only classroom props and are safe for school. For two people, try the duets; for one, the monologues.
